label: Fair
corporate_parent: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. — South Korean conglomerate
manufacturing_location: Newberry, South Carolina; South Korea; Vietnam

burner_system.description: Standard sealed burners — commodity components. No pro-style differentiation.

construction.body: Residential slide-in construction — builder-grade positioning with smart features
construction.smart_features: WiFi, Air Fry, smart connectivity via SmartThings. These features add electronic complexity and potential failure points.

oven_convection.description: Fan-assisted convection — NOT true European. Fan circulates air from standard bake/broil elements. Inferior to true European convection.

performance_evidence.simmer_detail: Poor simmer control — standard sealed burner limitations without precision valve engineering
performance_evidence.oven_temp_uniformity: ≥13°F estimated — fan-assisted convection produces less uniform results than true European
performance_evidence.boil_time: fair — standard sealed burners, no performance advantage
performance_evidence.smart_features: WiFi, Air Fry, SmartThings — features that differentiate on paper but add failure points

yale_service_rate.notes: Samsung gas ranges NOT in Yale service data. However, cross-category Samsung pattern is consistent: dishwashers, refrigerators, wall ovens all show above-average service rates and service ecosystem problems.

recall_history.description: CRITICAL SAFETY SIGNAL: Samsung recalled 1.1 million slide-in electric ranges (August 2024, CPSC). Front-mounted knobs can be accidentally activated by humans or pets, potentially igniting flammable items. 300+ incidents, ~250 fires, 40 injuries, pet deaths reported.
recall_history.correction: This recall is for ELECTRIC slide-in ranges, not gas. However, it is a material cross-category safety signal about Samsung range design (front-mounted knob activation risk applies to gas models with similar knob placement).
recall_history.remedy: Free knob locks/covers. Request via samsung.com/us/support/range-knob-kit or 833-775-0120.

common_failures.control_board: Control board failures documented across Samsung appliance categories — pattern failure. Temperature sensor (thermistor) and display panel failures also reported.
common_failures.cross_category_pattern: Samsung control board reliability issues are consistent across dishwashers, refrigerators, wall ovens, and ranges. This is a cross-category corporate engineering concern.

warranty.description: 1-year standard warranty. Warranty claim process documented as adversarial in multiple categories.

service_network.description: Samsung offers branded in-home service with certified technicians. Third-party authorized providers (Sears Home Services, Mr. Appliance) also available. HOWEVER: service availability varies significantly by region. The gap is TECHNICIAN AVAILABILITY, not parts availability.
service_network.critical_correction: Samsung parts ARE available at RepairClinic and Samsung direct. The problem is finding qualified technicians, not sourcing parts. This correction was established in the dishwasher category deep dive.

parts_availability.description: Genuine OEM parts available through RepairClinic, Samsung direct, and authorized distributors. Model-specific lookup, same-day shipping available.

control_board.notes: Cross-category pattern: control board failures are Samsung's most consistent reliability weakness. Documented in dishwashers, refrigerators, wall ovens, and ranges.

safety_evidence.recalls: 1.1M electric slide-in range recall (CPSC August 2024) — front-mounted knob activation fire hazard. 300+ incidents, ~250 fires, 40 injuries. Gas model knob placement may present similar risk.
safety_evidence.gas_emissions: NO₂ non-differentiated by brand — ventilation is the intervention
safety_evidence.class_actions: Consumer complaints and investigations into potential defects in Samsung and Dacor gas cooking appliances documented

platform_disclosure.samsung_dacor: INVESTIGATION: Dacor (acquired by Samsung 2016) suspected to share Samsung-sourced components. Consumer complaints and investigations reference both Samsung and Dacor gas cooking appliances together.
platform_disclosure.cross_category_signal: Samsung range recall + dishwasher reliability + refrigerator reliability patterns compound to form a cross-category corporate reliability concern.

corrections.corrected_value: Recall is for ELECTRIC slide-in ranges, not gas. Knob activation hazard may still apply to gas models with similar design.
corrections.reason: Deep dive confirmed CPSC recall is for electric models. Calibration notes referenced it as gas — this is a material correction.

S: Yale Appliance (no Samsung gas range data — absence noted)
